title: Join the work.
intro: Three ways to help Joyce get back to work for Bomet's women.

pledge.title: Pledge your vote
pledge.body: Tell us you'll vote for Joyce on 10 August 2027. We count pledges by ward so we know where to campaign.

volunteer.title: Volunteer in your ward
volunteer.body: Help with door-to-door visits, women's group meetings, or polling-day work as an agent.

whatsapp.title: Follow on WhatsApp
whatsapp.body: Campaign updates, events and the record — straight to your phone.
